title: Swing feel — a ratio on the global measure
description: The same line of eight eighth notes in every bar, played four different ways. Bar 1 declares `_x.mnxLab.swing` 2:1 on the eighth (the triplet feel Guitar Pro writes as `Triplet8th`) and prints the marking; bar 2 declares nothing and inherits it, printing nothing — a feel persists until another bar changes it; bar 3 declares 3:1 and prints the dotted realisation; bar 4 declares 1:1 and prints `Straight`, which is how a swing is cancelled. Nothing in the written notation moves: the whole difference lives in the performance evidence, where the first eighth of each pair takes 2/3, then 3/4, then half of its pair. Pins the engraved marking in all three views and the compiled warp.
